assertions.text: Runs scripts/install-widget.ps1 (optionally -DryRun first) instead of downloading an installer from somewhere
Treats a failing pnpm verify as a stop condition and reports the failing output rather than passing -SkipVerify on its own
Reports from the final status block that the running process and the autostart entry both point at the installed exe under %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\ai-usage-widget
Tells the user that account sign-in and the Claude bridge install happen in the widget and does not attempt to sign in for them

cases.prompt: is the usage widget running and where does its autostart point?

assertions.text: Uses -Status, which changes nothing, rather than reinstalling
If autostart names another executable, explains that starting the installed app once re-registers it and that an entry switched off in Task Manager is left alone
When -Uninstall exits 3 because the Claude statusline bridge is installed, stops and asks the user to press [기본 프로필에서 제거] in the widget first
Does not add -Force without the user's explicit confirmation
Mentions that user data and CLI sign-in folders are kept after uninstall
Recognises this as a code change, not an install, and points to apps/ai-usage-widget with its fixed reading list (CLAUDE.md, DECISIONS.md, STATE.md, docs/HANDOFF.md)
